source_text_policy: Only naturally occurring HTML paragraphs; no structured-field concatenation.
review_status: Automatic checks only; all category/field suggestions require human review.
quality_findings: Candidate proposals are not extraction gold.
Natural paragraph selection often omits details elsewhere on a page. Missing fields must be annotated against the stored input, not the full page.
Source diversity is not balanced class coverage; repeated annual competition pages may share templates.
Automated duplicate-page exclusions and character-decoding repairs are separately preserved.
